v2.0.6 Update
Fixed a black readiness screen when an All-Out voting macro used the Blackout Cut effect. Character readiness images now remain visible, and the effect starts when the cut-in plays.

v2.0.6: All-Out Readiness Fix

  • All-Out voting macros using Blackout Cut now show character readiness images while players join. The effect starts when the cut-in plays.
